title: Average cost of computing OR
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<p<1$, and let $A$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. If a decision tree with sign-valued queries and sign-valued outputs computes the function that returns $1$ exactly when every coordinate in $A$ has value $1$, then its expected number of queries under the product distribution of independent signs with probability $p$ of being $-1$ is at least $\sum_{k=0}^{|A|-1}(1-p)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite coordinate set of size n
A decision tree with sign queries and sign outputs
The tree computes the specified OR function
